subject: Rollout handoff: timeline, enablement windows & exception routing
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Rollout handoff: timeline, enablement windows & exception routing

Team —

We need to lock the operational handoff for Atlas Health feature set 1 so we can start scheduling customer enablement sessions next week. High-level asks:

- Confirm the go/no-go timeline (document freeze, cutover, post-cutover validation windows)
- Assign doc + training owners for the customer-facing guides and internal runbooks
- Define exception routing (who owns on-call, escalation to Product, SLA for rollback decisions)

I attached a first-pass handoff matrix (handoff_matrix_v1.csv) — please review and add owners in column C. Major constraints: legal wants final doc freeze by EOD Thurs so ProcureOps can complete contract redlines for a few pilot customers.

Proposed cadence: quick sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize owners, then a short readout with Sales/CS on Thursday. If there are any blockers that require leadership sign-off, flag them here so we can escalate.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Launch Lead, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
(attachment: handoff_matrix_v1.csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollout handoff: timeline, enablement windows & exception routing

Priya — thanks for kicking this off. I updated the matrix with a proposed timeline and marked the items I think require engineering validation before we sign off. Summary of suggested schedule (high level):

- Wed 6/13: Docs owner confirmation + draft training deck (internal)
- Thu 6/14 EOD: Documentation freeze for pilot customers (per legal ask)
- Fri 6/15: Internal enablement session + dry-run for CS (1 hour)
- Mon 6/18 08:00–11:00 PT: Cutover window (low-traffic period)
- Mon 6/18 11:00–15:00 PT: Post-cutover validation and smoke checks

Exception routing proposal: if an issue is detected during cutover that violates our latency SLO by >30% and affects >5% of pilot requests, trigger an immediate rollback decision. On-call ownership: Platform SRE first, then ad-hoc Product lead (I'll be primary Product contact for the pilot). I attached a sketch of the routing diagram for clarity.

(attachment: exception_routing_diagram.pdf)

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, GTM Operations
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollout handoff: timeline, enablement windows & exception routing

+1 on Ben's timeline. I've populated the docs_owner_list.xlsx with owners and deadlines — main notes:

- Customer Quickstart Guide: Owner = Laura Bennett (docs due 6/14 EOD)
- Internal Runbook (cutover steps + validation checklist): Owner = Aditya Rao (draft due 6/13 EOD)
- Training Deck for CS: Owner = Tessa Morgan (dry-run 6/15)

We should also include a short 'Known Limitations' section in each doc that clearly states rollback criteria and supported model variants. Aditya — can you include a one-page rollback checklist in the runbook? If you want, I started the sheet with suggested checkpoints.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Developer Docs
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
(attachment: docs_owner_list.xlsx)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollout handoff: timeline, enablement windows & exception routing

Couple of operational notes from enablement perspective:

- CS needs a 45-minute technical demo slot that includes a short troubleshooting checklist. Who will present the live demo? (Ben/Aditya?)
- For exception routing, we need a single Slack channel that is mirrored to the on-call page so CS can triage with SRE. Suggest channel: #pilot-atlas-health-cutover.
- Will ProcureOps be looped for the pilot contract amendments or are we using the existing template? If any contract changes are expected during the window, we need a decision by Thu morning.

Quick answers: I can run the CS dry-run on 6/15 if Aditya can be available for the demo portion. Also happy to coordinate the Slack channel setup.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Enablement Manager
tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

From: Alex Johnson <alex@acmeai.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@neptune-inc.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollout handoff: timeline, enablement windows & exception routing

Thanks for the update — a few items from the customer side:

- Acme's engineers need the docs by Thu EOD to schedule their internal dry-run on Fri. Can you confirm the final doc delivery ETA?
- For the training/demo, we'll need a short sandbox link or credentials to exercise the integration during the dry-run. Is that something you can provision ahead of Fri?
- On exceptions: if a rollback is triggered during the pilot, what is the customer notification SLA? We need to notify our security/compliance team within 2 hours per our policy.

If possible, put the sandbox credentials in a temporary shared Drive folder and notify Alex and the ProcureOps contact directly.

Alex Johnson
Engineering Manager, Acme AI
alex@acmeai.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex@acmeai.com>, ProcureOps <procure@neptune-inc.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollout handoff: timeline, enablement windows & exception routing

Thanks everyone — quick consolidation of decisions and owners so we have a single source of truth:

Decisions:
- Doc freeze: Thu 6/14 EOD (legal/ProcureOps requirement)
- Cutover window: Mon 6/18 08:00–11:00 PT; post-cutover validation 11:00–15:00 PT
- Rollback criteria: latency SLO breach >30% affecting >5% of pilot traffic (immediate rollback)
- Customer notification SLA on rollback: 2 hours (agreed with Acme)

Owners / Actions:
- Docs: Laura (final due 6/14 EOD) — docs_owner_list.xlsx
- Internal runbook + rollback checklist: Aditya (draft 6/13, final 6/14) — please include the one-page checklist
- CS dry-run & training deck: Tessa (dry-run 6/15)
- Product contact during pilot: Ben (primary)
- Platform SRE on-call: (Ben to coordinate roster; set up #pilot-atlas-health-cutover Slack channel)
- Sandbox creds and Drive link: Ben to provision and notify Alex/ProcureOps by Fri 6/15 AM

Next steps:
1) Aditya — upload runbook + rollback_checklist.md to the shared Drive by EOD Wed so Laura can reference it in the customer docs.
2) Ben — set up Slack channel and share ProcureOps + Alex the Drive link (put sandbox creds in a restricted folder) by Fri AM.
3) Tessa — schedule CS dry-run (45 min) for 6/15; invite Ben/Aditya as presenters.

If no objections, I'll run the readout with Sales/CS Thu 6/14 at 11am PT (calendar invite to follow). Thanks all for the quick turn.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Launch Lead, Redwood Inference
(attachments referenced: handoff_matrix_v1.csv, docs_owner_list.xlsx, exception_routing_diagram.pdf, rollback_checklist.md)
